name: Marco Becattini
biography: I am a PhD student in Smart Computing at the University of Florence, where I am part of the Software Technologies Laboratory (STLab) in the Department of Information Engineering, under the supervision of Prof. Enrico Vicario.

My research investigates how software engineering principles and techniques can be adapted to design and govern LLM-based multi-agent systems, with a focus on the themes of reliability and performance.
My work combines architectural approaches with empirical studies in industrial settings, particularly in telecommunications, and in educational settings.
When I am not in front of a Mac, I am usually surfing, studying Bach, reading C.G. Jung, or mixing cocktails.
interests: Reliability and performance in LLM-based multi-agent systems
